chunks: Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ narrated from Manṣūr ibn Yūnus Buzurj, from Jamīl ibn Darrāj, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say: “A free person and a slave do not inherit from one another.”

key_terms.لَا يَتَوَارَثُ: do not inherit mutually from one another

ai.seo_question: Do a free person and a slave inherit from one another in Islamic inheritance law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling in inheritance: reciprocal inheritance does not occur between a free person and an enslaved person. It belongs to the jurisprudence of estates and clarifies a status-based restriction in inheritance law.
